about: Every new line Take MeeMee Home says, in recording order (the 0.8.0 PRD's Lines tab). Ids start with the game's id (takehome-). It also says MeeMee Rescue's numbers (num-mid-0 to num-end-10), four of its praise lines, its try-again lines, tap-scruffles and too-many, shared with Barney's agreement (0.8.0 PRD, question 3): those stay in games/rescue/lines.json. "pending": true puts a line on the recording page but keeps it out of the game until it's recorded. The class uses every subtraction word (open question 2, answered 16 October 2026), so from 0.8.1 the number sentence takes turns: takehome-take-away, takehome-subtract and takehome-minus, and takehome-is and takehome-equals.
